technology_name: A SYSTEM FOR ASSESSING SUSTAINABILITY OF TROPICAL ABODES AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Architectural structural evaluations struggle to map the intersection of localized environmental, financial, and community metrics when auditing tropical building lifecycles.
description: An architectural software analysis suite built with a multi-tiered data capture module, a relational database tracking engine, an integrated computational weight processor, and an absolute sustainability vector visualization dashboard.
applications: Green building certification software systems, municipal smart city housing audits, tropical architectural design optimization suites, and structural engineering compliance tools.
